digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live testing & agent-driven root-cause probe
propositions: Rich-text defects in Jira DC cannot be efficiently root-caused today because observing live DC behavior requires a full 2-hour CI cycle per experiment, making incremental debugging prohibitively expensive.

An agentic in-CI investigator tool is needed that boots the ephemeral DC once and runs many live experiments in that single boot using rebar's own reconcile primitives and an LLM agent with run_python and jira_rest tools.
The investigator must be gated by opt-in environment variables and never run on ordinary push/PR/schedule, functioning only as an on-demand diagnostic workflow_dispatch.

The investigator must reuse existing pytest fixtures and produce a structured RichTextRca finding with cited experiment evidence, asserting that an investigation completed (not that the bug is fixed).
